items.t: Danaher Teams Up With Microsoft To Develop AI-Powered Scientific Instruments, First Applications Expected This Year
items.sum: The first commercial applications are expected to reach Danaher customers in 2026, with additional agent-enabled instruments planned for 2027.

items.t: Danaher Collaborates with Microsoft to Make Scientific Instruments Agentically Connected and Laboratories More Intelligent

items.t: Danaher Enters Strategic Partnership With Microsoft To Develop Smart Scientific Instruments And Interoperable Agentic Ecosystem To Connect Technologies
